source.title: Change in the Board of Directors (July 2021)
source.content:
With the terms of Board Member Ethan Pride coming to an end, an anonymous election took place on June 30, 2021 to elect new members. The election was done according to [Motion 5.2021.1: Election of Directors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2021.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf).

The Board received applications from:

Ethan Pride

We are happy to announce that the election was successful and that Ethan was re-elected as a member of the WCA Board of Directors! We wish him the best of luck with his duties!

Ethan’s application can be viewed [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HVktU7HZLk5oLUNfpD4MDm2hTqaqOQHm?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WCA 董事会成员变动（2021 年 7 月）
translation.content:
Ethan Pride 的董事任期即将结束，WCA 于 2021 年 6 月 30 日举行了不记名选举，选出新一届成员。此次选举依据[动议 5.2021.1——董事选举](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/05.2021.1%20-%20Election%20of%20Directors.pdf)进行。

董事会收到以下申请：

* Ethan Pride

我们很高兴地宣布，选举顺利完成，Ethan 再次当选 WCA 董事！祝他履职顺利！

Ethan 的申请材料可在[这里](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HVktU7HZLk5oLUNfpD4MDm2hTqaqOQHm?usp=sharing)查看。
